metadata.headline: How does Getaround turn a private car into a self-service rental?

platform_lesson.title: Getaround makes a private car work more like a self-service rental car
platform_lesson.text: A normal peer-to-peer car rental often requires the owner and renter to meet and exchange keys. Getaround Connect changes that. A small device installed in the car lets an eligible renter book the vehicle, complete the check-in and unlock it with the Getaround app. The owner does not have to be there. This matters because one owner can make a car available for many more rental times without arranging every handover personally, while renters can book cars at short notice. Getaround says cars equipped with Connect receive at least twice as much demand. The platform still needs owners, renters, insurance and support, but Connect turns access to the physical asset into something the platform can manage digitally. In May 2026, GoMore acquired Getaround Europe; together the two networks reported more than 5 million users, 70,000 shared vehicles and 1.5 million rentals per year across 11 countries.

core_value_unit.explanation: The core value unit is temporary access to a listed vehicle. With Getaround Connect, that access can be granted digitally without the owner meeting the renter.

metrics.note: Combined annual rentals reported by Getaround and GoMore after the May 2026 acquisition; not Getaround-only volume.

actor.explanation: Getaround operates the marketplace and Connect technology. Getaround Europe was acquired by GoMore in May 2026.

metrics.note: Combined Getaround-GoMore footprint reported after the May 2026 acquisition.

job.explanation: Getaround has to make privately supplied cars easy to find, book and access without creating a traditional rental fleet.

gain.explanation: Higher booking frequency increases marketplace activity and owner earnings.

pain.explanation: Getaround must limit fraud, damage, access failures and periods when listed cars are unavailable.

transaction.explanation: Getaround coordinates the booking, payment, digital check-in and, for Connect cars, smartphone access.

governance.explanation: Getaround sets renter verification, vehicle eligibility, check-in, insurance and marketplace rules.

promotion_channel.explanation: Renters find nearby cars through the Getaround app, website and search.

activities.explanation: Getaround runs search, booking, payments, access technology, verification and support.

resources.explanation: Key resources include the Connect device and software, local vehicle supply, demand, identity and booking data.

actor.explanation: People rent nearby cars for a few hours or days instead of owning or using a traditional rental counter.

metrics.note: Combined Getaround-GoMore user community reported in May 2026; not a Getaround-only active-user count.

job.explanation: Renters need temporary access to a suitable nearby vehicle.

gain.explanation: A renter can find a local car and, for Connect rentals, unlock it without meeting the owner.

pain.explanation: Renters face local availability, total booking cost and eligibility or insurance restrictions.

transaction.explanation: Renters choose a car, book it and pay through Getaround.

filter.explanation: A useful listing must fit the renter's location, dates, price and vehicle requirements.

access_channel.explanation: The app manages booking and, on equipped vehicles, the digital check-in and unlock process.

activities.explanation: Renters search, book, inspect, unlock, drive and return the car.

resources.explanation: Renters contribute verified identity, payment, trip demand and reviews.

actor.explanation: Private and professional owners list vehicles and make them available for rental.

metrics.note: Combined shared vehicles reported by Getaround and GoMore after the May 2026 acquisition; not a Getaround-only active-car count.

job.explanation: Owners want to earn money from a vehicle when they are not using it.

gain.explanation: Rentals generate income and improve utilization of an otherwise parked asset.

pain.explanation: Owners face damage risk, maintenance work, cleaning and periods with no bookings.

transaction.explanation: Owners list a car and make it available for booked periods.

filter.explanation: Vehicles and owners must meet Getaround's eligibility and operating requirements.

access_channel.explanation: Owners manage availability, prices, bookings and earnings through Getaround tools.

activities.explanation: Owners list and maintain vehicles, set availability and prepare cars for renters.

resources.explanation: Owners contribute the vehicle, availability and physical access needed for the rental.

actor.explanation: Insurance partners make peer-to-peer rentals possible by covering the trip separately from the owner's everyday motor policy.

job.explanation: Partners provide liability, damage protection and support around insured rentals.

gain.explanation: A large rental network creates recurring insured trip volume.

pain.explanation: Insurers must manage accident, damage, fraud and eligibility risk.

transaction.explanation: Insurance protection sits around eligible rentals and limits financial exposure for owners and renters.

filter.explanation: Coverage depends on the driver, vehicle, market and compliance with rental conditions.

access_channel.explanation: Getaround embeds the relevant insurance and roadside-assistance layer into the booking.

activities.explanation: Insurance partners provide coverage and support claims when covered incidents occur.

resources.explanation: Partners contribute insurance capacity, underwriting expertise and claims infrastructure.

current.explanation: The renter chooses a vehicle, books the rental and pays through Getaround.
Getaround provides the digital rental flow and, for Connect cars, app-based access together with the embedded trip-protection layer.
The owner lists a vehicle and makes selected time slots available to the marketplace.
Getaround sends bookings to the owner and pays rental earnings after applicable service charges.
Insurance partners provide trip coverage and risk capacity for eligible rentals.
The marketplace channels insurance economics and claims activity into the insurance layer.
